title: Between Myths and Metaphors: Rethinking LLMs for SRH in Conservative Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance on interpreting indirect clinical communication (e.g., semantic drift, polysemy) in Roman Urdu, measuring interpretive correctness, response coherence, and script stability (e.g., avoiding inappropriate code-switching into Hinglish or other scripts).

Assessing the ability of LLMs to accurately understand culturally specific euphemisms, colloquialisms, and folk myths related to sexual and reproductive health (SRH) in conservative Pakistani contexts.
Analyzing LLM responses to determine if the generated medical explanations are accessible to patients with low health literacy and education, or if the models default to overly technical jargon.
